problem: SlotValue::Arbitrary generates 8 symbolic variants including recursive handle types (List, Object, Blob). WorkflowParts::Arbitrary creates unbounded nested structures. Kani explores all paths resulting in exponential timeout (>5-10 min). Baseline harness (no SlotValue arbitrary) passes in 0.023s.
root_cause: Harness design flaw: kani::any::<SlotValue>() is unnecessarily over-symbolic for testing taint validity (INV-006), signal mapping (INV-002), slot init (INV-003), and PC bounds (INV-004). The Arbitrary impl at kani_workflow_arbitrary.rs:487-499 creates deep symbolic branching that Kani cannot exhaustively explore within reasonable time.
required_fix: Restrict SlotValue::Arbitrary usage in harnesses to simple variants only (Null, Bool, I64, F64, Symbol). Add kani::assume guards: kani::assume(matches!(value, SlotValue::Null | SlotValue::Bool(_) | SlotValue::I64(_))) or create bounded_simple_slot_value(). For WorkflowParts harnesses, bound node_count <= 4 and use only simple CompiledNodeKind variants. Redesign harnesses targeting INV-002/INV-003/INV-004 to avoid deep symbolic workflow construction.
evidence: Baseline: cargo kani --harness join_taint_ge_first_arg -> SUCCESS 0.023s. taint_validity_harness (uses SlotValue::any()) -> TIMEOUT >5 min. step_once_bounds_harness -> TIMEOUT >10 min.
